import zipfile, os, subprocess, tempfile, random, pathlib
z='../decompress_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip'
out='/tmp/jpegs4'; os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(z) as f:
    names=[n for n in f.namelist() if n.endswith('.jpg')]
    for n in names[:200]:
        p=os.path.join(out, os.path.basename(n))
        open(p,'wb').write(f.read(n))
        r=subprocess.run(['./fuzz/transform_fuzzer_2_0_x', p], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        if r.returncode!=0:
            print('CRASH', n, r.returncode)
            print(r.stdout.decode('latin1')[-2000:])
            break
    else:
        print('no crash in 200')
